definitions.explanation: A telephone call that includes video, allowing callers to see each other.

examples.japanese: {海外|かいがい}の{家族|かぞく}とテレビ{電話|でんわ}で{話|はな}す。
examples.english: I talk to my family overseas via video call.

examples.japanese: テレビ{電話|でんわ}で{会議|かいぎ}をする。
examples.english: To have a meeting via video call.

examples.japanese: スマホでテレビ{電話|でんわ}ができる。
examples.english: You can make video calls on a smartphone.

notes:
テレビ{電話|でんわ} literally means "TV phone"—a call where participants can see each other.

WORD FORMATION:
テレビ (TV) + {電話|でんわ} (telephone)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- テレビ{電話|でんわ}をかける: to make a video call
- テレビ{電話|でんわ}で{話|はな}す: to talk via video call
- テレビ{電話|でんわ}{会議|かいぎ}: video conference

SYNONYMS:
- ビデオ{通話|つうわ}: video call
- ビデオチャット: video chat
- オンライン{通話|つうわ}: online call

USAGE:
Widely used for remote work ({在宅|ざいたく}{勤務|きんむ}) and staying connected with family abroad. Common apps include LINE, Zoom, Skype, and FaceTime.
